national_news.title: Digital self-enumeration for Census 2027 begins in Ladakh today
bullets: The entire Union Territory of Ladakh will undergo Population Enumeration, the second phase of Census 2027 in September.
Self-Enumeration is scheduled from August 17 to 31 in the Union Territory.
Ladakh would become the first Union Territory in the country to complete the Census 2027 exercise.

national_news.title: NTA Announces Re-Test for Three UGC-NET June 2026 Papers
bullets: NTA announced re-test for three UGC-NET papers: English, Commerce, and Sociology.
The re-test will be held on 9th and 10th September for the respective papers.
The decision was taken following complaints about several errors in the original papers.

national_news.title: MoS Dr Jitendra Singh to Confer National Anubhav Awards 2026 in New Delhi
bullets: National Anubhav Awards 2026 will be conferred by MoS Dr Jitendra Singh in New Delhi.
Handbook on Pension Mitra and Guidelines for the Nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-Five will be released.
A Bank Exhibition will be organised, featuring 17 Pension Disbursing Banks showcasing their products and services.

national_news.title: Magnus Carlsen wins Esports World Cup chess title for second consecutive year
bullets: Magnus Carlsen won the Esports World Cup title for the second year in a row by defeating Denis Lazavik 2-0 in Paris, France.
He remained undefeated throughout the tournament, representing Team Liquid.
American Grandmaster Hikaru Nakamura secured third place after defeating Alireza Firouzja 4-1 in a chaotic bronze-medal match.
